findings.problem: Der Kerl is also a common informal word for a guy you don't know, so this hint lets in a second right answer.
findings.fix: hint: informal, a man you don't know; the word that also means type (not Kerl)

back.example: Who is that guy over there?

note: In the guy sense Typ takes weak endings (den Typen, des Typen), unlike the type sense (des Typs); this may be worth mentioning when case cards come up.
